title_original: GXO and Agility Robotics Expand Partnership to Accelerate Deployment of Humanoids in U.S. Operations
title_zh: GXO与Agility宣布扩大Digit仓储合作，计划2027年进入两处新站点
title_en: GXO and Agility plan Digit deployments at two additional US sites in 2027
summary_zh: 双方10月26日宣布，计划在美国北卡罗来纳州Statesville和田纳西州Lebanon的GXO站点部署Digit，用于电商履约中的重复搬运；预计2027年初先使用Digit 4，之后在Digit 5商业化时迁移。GXO称，现有佐治亚州站点已搬运超过10万个周转箱。
summary_en: GXO and Agility announced planned Digit deployments at GXO sites in Statesville, North Carolina, and Lebanon, Tennessee, for repetitive material handling. They expect to begin with Digit 4 in early 2027 and move to Digit 5 when available. GXO says the existing Georgia deployment has moved more than 100,000 totes.
why_it_matters_zh: 现有商业试点向多站点扩展，为观察人形机器人在仓库的持续运营提供后续样本。
limitations_zh: 新站点尚未开始部署；周转箱数据为双方披露，未提供独立审计或生产率对照。

title_original: ANYbotics Starts Customer Deliveries of ANYmal X, the World’s First Legged Robot Built for Explosive Atmospheres
title_zh: ANYbotics宣布开始向客户交付防爆巡检四足机器人ANYmal X
title_en: ANYbotics says customer deliveries of ANYmal X have begun
summary_zh: ANYbotics于10月27日宣布开始向油气和化工客户交付ANYmal X，并点名Equinor与DSM-Firmenich。该机器人面向易爆环境巡检，配置热成像、视觉、声学和气体传感器；公司称它符合ATEX与IECEx要求。
summary_en: ANYbotics announced the start of ANYmal X deliveries to oil, gas and chemical customers, naming Equinor and DSM-Firmenich. The legged inspection system uses thermal, visual, acoustic and gas sensing for hazardous areas; the company says it meets ATEX and IECEx requirements.
why_it_matters_zh: 由早期测试转向客户交付，是危险区域自主巡检商业化的可追踪节点。
limitations_zh: 交付数量、单点运行效果及客户验收文件未披露；‘全球首款’为公司说法。

title_original: Yaskawa Electric and GAZOO Racing Hone and Evolve Welding Technology in Motorsports
title_zh: 安川与GAZOO Racing披露机器人焊接系统已用于GR KART生产
title_en: Yaskawa and GAZOO Racing disclose AI-assisted robotic welding in GR KART production
summary_zh: 双方10月28日首次详细披露：基于SFA焊接工艺的MOTOMAN NEXT系统已于9月在蒲郡GR KART工坊投入使用。按双方公告，机器人能识别管件间隙和温度等条件，并执行焊后检查与修正。
summary_en: On October 28, Yaskawa and GAZOO Racing disclosed that a MOTOMAN NEXT system based on their SFA welding process had entered use at the Gamagori GR KART workshop in September. They say it assesses conditions including pipe gaps and temperature, then performs post-weld inspection and correction.
why_it_matters_zh: 展示了工业机器人从固定焊接程序走向条件识别与质量修正的生产现场案例。
limitations_zh: 9月已开始导入；10月的新事件是首次详细公开。良率、节拍和独立质量测试未披露。

title_original: AGIBOT Launches Genie Studio 2.0 to Bring Robots into Real Workplaces
title_zh: 智元发布Genie Studio 2.0具身应用开发与部署平台
title_en: AGIBOT launches Genie Studio 2.0 for embodied AI deployment
summary_zh: 智元10月26日发布Genie Studio 2.0，整合模型开发迭代、任务编排和机器人群管理三个模块。公司展示PIA Automation试点验证线：三台G2机器人协作进行电池管理系统控制器部件上料、装配、装箱及料箱转运。
summary_en: AGIBOT launched Genie Studio 2.0 with modules for model iteration, task orchestration and fleet operations. Its announcement describes a PIA Automation pilot line where three G2 robots handle loading, assembly, packing and bin transfer for battery-management controllers.
why_it_matters_zh: 将训练、仿真验证与现场运行纳入同一工作流，提供可继续观察的工厂试点。
limitations_zh: 七天部署和仿真与真机差异等性能表述为公司宣称；未见独立测试协议。

title_original: AGIBOT Introduces Worken to Measure Productive Robot Work at AGIBOT Innovation Day 2026
title_zh: 智元创新日发布G2 Max与灵渠OS 1.0，并提出Worken工作量指标
title_en: AGIBOT unveils G2 Max, Link-U OS 1.0 and proposed Worken metric
summary_zh: 智元在10月29日创新日发布重载工业机器人G2 Max，宣称双臂搬运能力最高40公斤；同时介绍灵渠OS 1.0和衡量机器人有效工作的Worken概念。官方英文稿指出OS仍在选定伙伴中试用，计划到2026年底完全开源。
summary_en: At its October 29 Innovation Day, AGIBOT launched the G2 Max industrial robot, claiming up to 40 kg dual-arm handling, and introduced Link-U OS 1.0 and a proposed Worken measure of productive robot work. Its English release says the OS is in selected-partner trials, with full open sourcing planned by year-end.
why_it_matters_zh: 硬件、系统软件与运行指标同步发布，后续可核对开源兑现及实际作业数据。
limitations_zh: G2 Max型号此前已亮相；本次为正式发布。OS尚未完全开放，Worken不是独立标准，性能和部署数据来自公司。

title_original: 鴻海科技日揭示AI代理與醫療機器人 打造新一代智慧醫療
title_zh: 鸿海科技日展示医疗场域具身智能与机器人方案
title_en: Hon Hai presents embodied intelligence and medical robots at its Technology Day
summary_zh: 鸿海10月30日公告称，科技日智慧医疗展区展示医疗场域具身智能、AI辅助诊断与医疗制造的整合方案，说明其机器人与医疗软件布局。公告以展出和合作介绍为主。
summary_en: Hon Hai's October 30 announcement says its Technology Day medical exhibit presented embodied intelligence for care settings alongside AI-assisted diagnosis and medical manufacturing. The release mainly describes demonstrations and partnerships.
why_it_matters_zh: 医疗机器人与医院信息系统的结合提供产业应用观察方向。
limitations_zh: 未披露具体医疗机器人临床验证、批准或规模部署数据；不能据展出推断已经临床使用。

title_original: Agility Robotics and Churchill Capital Corp XI Announce Expected Gross Capital Raise of Approximately $465 Million and Anticipated Closing of Business Combination
title_zh: Agility预计合并交易相关总筹资约4.65亿美元，交割仍待批准
title_en: Agility expects roughly $465 million gross proceeds from proposed combination
summary_zh: Agility与Churchill XI于10月30日称，拟议企业合并及相关融资预计带来约4.65亿美元总筹资额（未扣交易费用），其中约1.64亿美元来自信托账户、约2.01亿美元来自PIPE，另有已收到的1亿美元股权融资。交易仍需Churchill XI股东批准及满足惯常条件。
summary_en: Agility and Churchill XI said on October 30 that the proposed combination and related financing were expected to provide about $465 million in gross capital before expenses: roughly $164 million from the trust, $201 million from a PIPE and $100 million in equity funding already received. Closing remains subject to shareholder approval and other conditions.
why_it_matters_zh: 若完成，将为Digit商业扩张提供资金；相关时间与金额可在后续披露中核对。
limitations_zh: 交易尚未完成，筹资额为预期值，不能写成已到账资金；原公告提到的订单是多年潜在合同价值，不是当期收入。
